Using Spotify and tracking is out of sync?
.fmbot uses your Last.fm account for knowing what you listen to. Unfortunately, Last.fm and Spotify sometimes have issues keeping up to date with your current song, which can cause .fm and other commands to lag behind the song you're currently listening to. First, .fmbot is not affiliated with Last.fm. Your music is tracked by Last.fm, and not by .fmbot. This means that this is a Last.fm issue and not an .fmbot issue. We can't fix it for you, but we can give you some tips that worked for others. Some things you can try that usually work:
  • Restarting your Spotify application
  • Disconnecting and reconnecting Spotify in your Last.fm settings If the two options above don't work, check out the complete guide for this issue on the Last.fm support forums.

well, long story short: i've been listening a lot to d4vds music lately and got a chance to see him perform in portugal 2 nights ago. only heard about his concert 2 days before, so i hopped on my motorcycle and traveled 500km (± 310 miles) specifically to see him. on the day of his concert, i got in early and was the first person standing on the exact same stage he was going to perform on. sat there for around 6 hours until the concert began. it was totally worth the wait. best concert of my fucking life. loved every single second. at the end, i flew to the gate near backstage so i could see him get down the stairs of the stage. as soon as i saw him, me and a few guys that did the same as me started yelling for him. because of that, i got to hug him, tell him how important his music was to me, and got him to sign my arm. well, 2 days later (as soon as i could), i tattooed it. it was an experience i'll never forget, and i'll never support an artist as much as i'll ever support this guy
